champions.active: Summon a Sand Soldier near target and command them to strike. If 2 Soldiers are already out, they all immediately deal 70/105/5000% AP as magic damage instead.
champions.name: Azir

champions.passive: Immune to Crowd Control effects. Attacks deal damage in a line on target. If no enemies are in range, dash to the next one and knock up adjacent enemies on arrival. While in the Void Rift, erupt a tentacle below a random enemy every 0.25 seconds that knocks them up for 1.5 seconds.
champions.active: Slam and erect spikes in a 2 hex circle, dealing (250/375/20000% AD + 30/45/500% AP) as physical damage to enemies hit. Then over 3 seconds, spit 10 globs of acid that deal 40/45/50% of Spike damage as physical damage.
champions.unlockable: {{sbc|Field in combat:}} Level 10 + Field 7 unique {{TFTt|Void|set=16}} units.
champions.name: Baron Nashor

champions.passive: Immune to Crowd Control effects. Attacks briefly knock up the target and deal 50% damage in a 1 hex radius around them.
champions.active: Slam the ground, dealing (2% max Health + 150/200/1500% AD) as physical damage to ALL enemies, reduced by 15% for each hex from the center (down to 40%.) If this is the first time they've been hit by Seismic Slam this combat, knock them up for up to 1.75 seconds. 12/12/99 rocks fall around the battlefield, each dealing (200/375/600% AD + 20/30/100% AP) as physical damage to enemies hit.
champions.unlockable: Collect 500 {{TFTt|Ixtal|set=16}} {{tiptft|sunshard|Sunshards}} over the course of the game.
champions.name: Brock

champions.active: Teleport into a large cluster of enemies within 2 hexes and Stun them for 1.25/1.25/99 seconds. Begin losing 22 mana per second. While casting, deal 100/150/6666% AP as magic damage per second to all enemies within a 2 hex radius. The closest 2 enemies take 33% more damage.
champions.name: Fiddlesticks

champions.passive: Every 3rd attack deals 380/570/9000% MR as magic damage in a circle around the target.
champions.active: Dash into the largest group of units and inspire all allies within 2 hexes, granting them 500/600/2000% AP Shield for 4 seconds. Then crash down, dealing (350/525/5000% MR + 150/225/1000% Armor) as bonus magic damage to all enemies with 2 hexes.
champions.unlockable: {{sbc|Field in combat:}} 12 unique star levels of {{TFTt|Demacia|set=16}}.
champions.name: Galio

champions.active: Dash, then create a 2-hex radius zone for 2.5/2.5/99 seconds that shields allies within for 350/750/10000% AP for the zone's duration. While active, double current Attack Speed and on attack, fire a secondary arrow at a nearby enemy that deals 25/38/999% AD as physical damage. When the zone ends, heal all allies for 8% AP of damage dealt while it was up and dash away.
champions.name: Kindred

champions.active: Dawning Shadow (set=16): Fire a massive beam at the furthest enemy. Enemies hit take 230/350/2000% AD as physical damage, reduced by 8% per enemy hit, up to 40%. Allies hit gain 180/270/2000% AP Shield for 4/4/15 seconds.</br>The Culling (set=16): Fire 12/12/42 + 1 per 20% AS shots towards target. Each shot explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing (75/120/800% AD + 8/12/100% AP) as physical damage to all nearby enemies.
champions.name: Lucian & Senna

champions.passive: While gaining Mana, throw out 2/2/9 radiant orbs that orbit around target. They deal 65/100/150% AP as magic damage in a 1 hex radius and drain 1 Mana from enemies hit each second. After draining 235/235/10 mana, gain a random Radiant [[TFT:Item|Item]].
champions.active: Detonate orbs on target, causing a 3 hex radius explosion that deals 1000/1500/10000% AP as magic damage to them and 400/600/10000& AP damage to all other enemies hit.
champions.unlockable: {{sl|2}}2-Star {{TFTc|Ambessa|set=16}} with an item dies in combat.
champions.name: Mel

champions.abilityicon: Ornn Call of the Forge God.png
champions.active: Summon an elemental from behind the farthest enemy. It 20% Chills enemies hit for 3 seconds and deals 100/150/3000% AP as magic damage to them. When it arrives, headbutt it and redirect it toward another distant enemy, dealing 150/225/4500% AP as magic damage instead. Chill: Reduce Attack Speed.
champions.name: Ornn

champions.active: Release a runic blast, dealing 235/425/1500% AP as magic damage. It splits in two, dealing 33% of the damage to the closest two enemies. Each secondary blast splits an additional time. Bilgewater: Blasts explode on impact, dealing 25% of the damage as physical damage to adjacent enemies. Demacia: Execute targets below (12% + 1% per 5 Armor and MR) Health. Freljord: Chill targets for 4 seconds and deal 6% max Health as bonus true damage. Ionia: Blasts split an additional time, dealing 50% damage. Ixtal: Gain a random Region's effect on combat start and every 10 seconds. Noxus: Blasts now pierce targets, dealing 60% reduced damage per enemy hit. Piltover: Every third cast is Overcharged, dealing 40% more damage. Shadow Isles: Increase blast damage by (5% + 1% per 8 Souls). Shurima: Knock up enemies for 0.5 seconds, with a chance to dredge up Gold or Treasures. Targon: Heal the lowest Health ally for 10% of the damage dealt. Void: Ignore 30% of enemies' Armor and Magic Resistance. Yordle: Shrink targets hit, lowering their damage by 12% percent for 4 seconds. Zaun: Poison targets, dealing 15/30/500% AP as magic damage (3 + 1 per 40% bonus Attack Speed) times over 4 seconds.
champions.unlockable: {{sbc|Field in combat:}} Level 9 + 4 Region Traits together.
champions.name: Ryze

champions.active: Grab target and slam them forward, dealing 220/350/9999% AP + 3/9/900% AP of their max Health as magic damage to them. All other enemies within 3 hexes take 50% of the total damage.
champions.unlockable: {{sbc|Field in combat:}} Level 8 + Only 1 unit in the two front rows of the battlefield.
champions.name: Sett

champions.active: Dragon's Descent: Transform into a dragon, gaining 600/1000/9999 max Health. Briefly gain 20/20/90% Durability and dive-bomb into the largest group of enemies, dealing 100/150/3000% AD as physical damage in a 3 hex circle. Flame Breath: Breath fire in a cone for 3 seconds, dealing (185/275/12345% AD + 20/30/1234% AP) as physical damage each second to enemies hit.
champions.name: Shyvana

champions.active:
Cast one of three spells:
  • [[File:Jarvan IV Cataclysm.png|20px|link=]] Cataclysm: Leap on a nearby enemy. Deal 100/180/1000% AP as magic damage to all enemies within 2 hexes and Stun them for 1.5/1.75/30 seconds.
  • [[File:Garen Demacian Justice.png|20px|link=]] Demacian Justice: Deal 670/1000/99999% AP as magic damage to target. If they are below 15% max Health, execute them.
  • [[File:Lux Final Spark.png|20px|link=]] Final Spark: Gain 400/450/800% AP Shield for 1.25 seconds. Deal 300/475/1000% AP as magic damage to all enemies in a line.

champions.name: Sylas

champions.passive: Attacks fire a barrage of 4 bullets.
champions.active: Gain (10% max Health + 300/400/66666) Shield and begin consuming 33 mana per second. Each second while casting, fire a laser that deals (145/250/2000% AD + 10/15/150% AP) as physical damage, reduced by 25% per enemy hit up to 75%. Additionally, launch (4 + 1 per 25% AS) missiles split between 4 nearby enemies that each deal 25% of Laser Damage as physical damage.

champions.name: T-Hex

champions.active: Devour target for 2.5 seconds, dealing 1200/1800/30000% AP as magic damage and making them immune to other sources of damage. During this time, gain 30% Durability. If they are immune to crowd control, deal 1000/1500/20000% AP as magic damage instead. If they die while devoured, spit out a [[TFT:Item|random component]] they were holding or the unit's cost in gold. Otherwise, spit them towards the farthest enemy, briefly Stunning targets on impact.

champions.name: Tahm Kench

champions.passive: Each second, deal (30/50/400% AP + 1 per 15 Souls) as magic damage to all enemies within 2 hexes. Heal for 75% of the damage dealt by this effect.
champions.active: Create a prison of walls in a 2 hex radius that lasts 5/5/60 seconds. While active, the Passive's damage is doubled. When an enemy touches a wall, they take 100/150/4000% AP as magic damage. If there are less than 2 enemies inside The Box at any time, drag an enemy in.
champions.unlockable: Collect 175 {{TFTt|Shadow Isles|set=16}} {{tiptft|Souls}}.
champions.name: Thresh

champions.active: Bite the target and mark them, dealing (3% max Health + 100/150/2000% AD) as physical damage, increased by 60% if they are already marked. After casting 5/5/2 times, leap to a nearby hex, activating Stormbringer and dealing 200% of Bite damage as physical damage to enemies within a two hex radius. Stormbringer: Gain 400/550/9999 Health and 50/50/999% Attack Speed. Every 2/2/0.3 seconds, summon a lightning bolt on a nearby enemy, dealing (4% max Health + 50/75/999% AP) as magic damage. Takedowns summon a bolt on fallen enemies.
champions.unlockable: {{sbc|Field in combat:}} Level 8 + A unit that starts combat with {{as|3800 {{tiptft|Health|{{as|Health}}}}}}.

champions.active: Launch 10/10/99 arcane blasts randomly split between the closest 4/4/10 enemies that each deal 390/650/2500% AP as magic damage.

champions.name: Xerath

champions.active: Dash around target and slash in a circle, dealing (90/135/1500% AD + 20/30/200% AP) as physical damage to target and 40% of Slash damage as physical damage to all other adjacent enemies hit. If the target doesn't die, immediately cast again. If this Ability is cast 22 times in a row, instead slam on target, instantly killing them and dealing 200% of Slash damage as physical damage to all enemies within 3 hexes.

champions.passive: Attacks are replaced with a bomb that bounces 1 time, dealing (100% AD + 40/65/500% AP)) as magic damage to units hit.
champions.active: Throw an enormous bomb at the largest 4-hex group of enemies that explodes on impact, dealing between 70/105/3000% AP and 550/875/7000% AP as magic damage to enemies hit based on their distance from the epicenter.
champions.unlockable: {{sbc|Field in combat:}} Level 9 + A {{TFTt|Yordle|set=16}} or a {{TFTt|Zaun|set=16|Zaunite}} with 3 items equipped.
champions.name: Ziggs

champions.active: Throw a Time Bomb on the nearest enemy without one. Time Bombs deal 75/115/1000% AP as magic damage each second. When the target dies, they explode, dealing 150/225/4000% AP as magic damage in a 1 hex radius and grant Zilean 15 mana. If a Time Bomb is on an enemy for 18/16/1 seconds and Zilean is alive, the enemy instantly dies.
